text_en: A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches, and favor is better than silver or gold.
text_cn: 信誉比多财可取，敬仰比金银可贵。

text_en: The rich and the poor have this in common: the Lord is the maker of them all.
text_cn: 富人与穷人彼此相遇，二者皆为上主所造。

text_en: The clever see danger and hide; but the simple go on, and suffer for it.
text_cn: 精明人遇见灾祸，即行隐避；无知者反向前走，自招损害。

text_en: The reward for humility and fear of the Lord is riches and honor and life.
text_cn: 谦卑的赏报，是敬畏上主，是享有财富、尊荣和生命。

text_en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; the cautious will keep far from them.
text_cn: 邪恶者的路上，满布荆棘罗网；洁身自爱的人，必能远而避之。

text_en: Train children in the right way, and when old, they will not stray.
text_cn: 你教导孩童应行的道路，待他老年时也不会离弃。

text_en: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is the slave of the lender.
text_cn: 富人宰割穷人，债主奴役债户。

text_en: Whoever sows injustice will reap calamity, and the rod of anger will fail.
text_cn: 播种邪恶的，必收获灾祸；他辛苦工作，必全属徒劳。

text_en: Those who are generous are blessed, for they share their bread with the poor.
text_cn: 目光慈祥的，必蒙受祝福，因他将食粮，施舍给穷人。

text_en: Drive out a scoffer, and strife goes out; quarreling and abuse will cease.
text_cn: 赶走了狂人，就除了争执；争讼与侮辱，亦相继止息。

text_en: Those who love a pure heart and are gracious in speech will have the king as a friend.
text_cn: 纯洁的心灵，是上主所爱；优雅的唇舌，是君王所悦。

text_en: The eyes of the Lord keep watch over knowledge, but he overthrows the words of the faithless.
text_cn: 上主的眼目，常卫护知识；败类的言论，必加以毁灭。

text_en: The lazy person says, “There is a lion outside! I shall be killed in the streets! ”
text_cn: 只有懒人说：“外面有狮子，在街市之中，我会被吞噬”。

text_en: The mouth of a loose woman is a deep pit; he with whom the Lord is angry falls into it.
text_cn: 淫妇们的口，实是个深坑；上主恼怒的，必堕入其中。

text_en: Folly is bound up in the heart of a boy, but the rod of discipline drives it far away.
text_cn: 孩童心中藏愚昧，只有戒尺能驱逐。

text_en: Oppressing the poor in order to enrich oneself, and giving to the rich, will lead only to loss.
text_cn: 欺压穷人，是使他致富；馈赠富者，是使他贫穷。

text_en: The words of the wise: Incline your ear and hear my words, and apply your mind to my teaching;
text_cn: 你应当倾听智者的训言，应专心致意领会我的知识。

text_en: for it will be pleasant if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
text_cn: 你若细心存想，常在口中诵念，必会令你喜悦。

text_en: So that your trust may be in the Lord , I have made them known to you today—yes, to you.
text_cn: 为使你的信赖全托于上主，我今日特将道路指示给你。

text_en: Have I not written for you thirty sayings of admonition and knowledge,
text_cn: 关于教诲和知识，我岂未多次写过，

text_en: to show you what is right and true, so that you may give a true answer to those who sent you?
text_cn: 使你认识真言实理，答复前来问你的人？

text_en: Do not rob the poor because they are poor, or crush the afflicted at the gate;
text_cn: 你不可因为人穷而剥削穷人，亦不可在城门口欺压弱小者；

text_en: for the Lord pleads their cause and despoils of life those who despoil them.
text_cn: 因为他们的案件，上主必予以辩护；凡剥夺他们的人，上主必讨其生命。

text_en: Make no friends with those given to anger, and do not associate with hotheads,
text_cn: 易怒的人，不可与他交结，暴躁的人，不要与他往来，

text_en: or you may learn their ways and entangle yourself in a snare.
text_cn: 免得你沾染他的恶习，甘冒丧失性命的危险。

text_en: Do not be one of those who give pledges, who become surety for debts.
text_cn: 不要为别人击掌，不要为债务作保；

text_en: If you have nothing with which to pay, why should your bed be taken from under you?
text_cn: 免得你没有什么偿还时，连你的床榻也被人夺走。

text_en: Do not remove the ancient landmark that your ancestors set up.
text_cn: 祖先立定的旧界，你不要加以移动。

text_en: Do you see those who are skillful in their work? They will serve kings; they will not serve common people.
text_cn: 你曾见过办事能干的人吗？他必侍立在君王面前，决不侍立在庸人面前。
